name: format_materialize_clock
description: Empirical study for a proposed extension of `features/format`: can the three **temporal** formats be **materialized** — emitted as an idiomatic in-memory typed construct in the generated model (Go `time.Time`, Java `OffsetDateTime`/`LocalDate`/`LocalTime`, Python `datetime`/`date`/`time`, TS `Date`) — instead of the current `string` field, while keeping the **wire bytes byte-identical across every materializing language** (PRINCIPLES **P1**)?
